stories.title: 'I'm playing the best basketball of my career': How Caitlin Clark's game has grown in Year 3
stories.summary: Clark already has the most 20-point, 10-assist games in WNBA history. But her game remains a work in progress.

stories.title: Raiders' Cousins, Crosby scuffle at Friday practice
stories.summary: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins and star pass rusher Maxx Crosby got into a scuffle late in practice Friday before their teammates quickly jumped in and separated them.

stories.title: Purdue AD offers mea culpa over IU one-liner
stories.summary: New Purdue athletic director Tommy McClelland is owning that an attempted one-liner at the expense of Indiana was a mistake "the second it left my mouth."

stories.title: Sources: Titans' Skoronski gets $100M extension
stories.summary: The Titans have signed Peter Skoronski to a four-year, $100 million extension, making him the highest-paid guard in the NFL, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: WR Diggs ups claim: Best No. 1 'in my heart'
stories.summary: Stefon Diggs has changed teams for the third time in three years, but that hasn't dented his confidence.
